purpose: Teach: イルミネーション/ろうそく/洋食/新緑/売れ筋/ロース/ファンクラブ/家族連れ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、初めて見たイルミネーション、印象的だった。
lines.en: When I was young, the first time I saw Christmas lights… it left quite an impression.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Voice settles into a lower register. Pause before the ellipsis—letting the weight of it rest. Gentle, not melancholic.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。子供たちの誕生日、ろうそく灯して、毎年祝ったわね。
lines.en: Yes. We'd light candles for the children's birthdays every year and celebrate together.
lines.style: Warm recognition, like seeing an old photograph come alive. Rhythmic, almost lilting on the repeated years. Voice carries the weight of accumulated love, not sadness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: デートでよく行った洋食店、まだあるかな。
lines.en: That Western restaurant we used to go to on dates—I wonder if it's still there.
lines.style: Gentle wondering, more to himself than asking. Slight pause between thought and question. Voice lighter, caught between present and past tense.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 新緑の季節、二人で散歩、好きだったわ。
lines.en: Spring walks with you through the fresh greenery—I loved those days so much.
lines.style: Unhurried, savoring each image like tasting something cherished. Slight breath before 'fresh greenery.' The cadence of contentment, not yearning.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の売れ筋お菓子、今、手に入らないんだよな。
lines.en: Those old sweets that used to be everywhere—you can't find them anymore, you know.
lines.style: Wry observation, almost bemused. Light chuckle beneath the words. Not complaining, just noticing the gentle strangeness of time passing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ロース肉の煮込み、お孫さんの好物よ。
lines.en: Braised loin—it's still our grandchildren's favorite.
lines.style: Simple, factual statement carrying quiet pride. Voice brightens slightly. The comfort of continuity, not dwelling on loss.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の歌手のファンクラブ、今も会報、届いている。
lines.en: That old singer's fan club—their newsletter still arrives at the house.
lines.style: Dry amusement at the persistence of it all. Matter-of-fact delivery, with a hint of smile in the voice. Observing the peculiar durability of small loyalties.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 駅前の家族連れ、見ると、子育ての日々、思い出すわ。
lines.en: When I see families waiting by the station, it brings back all those days of raising our own children.
lines.style: Reflective, with a catch of recognition. Voice steadies, becomes present-tense in its attention. Not nostalgic—actually seeing them, in the moment. Warm but grounded.
